topic: Set up your LinkedIn for your first internship in one evening: headline formula, a four-line About, Featured project, photo, a first post and a checklist
save_reason: A one-slide LinkedIn profile checklist plus a copy-paste headline formula and About template (slide 8, full text in the caption).
send_reason: Send this to a friend making their LinkedIn this week.

cover.concept: Renaissance oil painting remixed with tech: a candlelit painter's studio, a large empty gilded portrait frame on a wooden easel with a softly glowing blank laptop screen set inside it where the portrait would be; brushes, a palette and drapery around it.
hooks: Set up your LinkedIn for your first internship. (ambition)
What a recruiter reads first on your LinkedIn. (curiosity)
A first-year LinkedIn can look this strong. (awe)
Fix your LinkedIn headline in ten minutes tonight. (confidence)

cover.lineDraft: Do it in one evening of first year.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Renaissance oil painting, museum quality, rich chiaroscuro, visible brushwork and fine craquelure, magazine-ad quality. A candlelit painter's studio: a large ornate empty gilded portrait frame stands on a wooden easel; inside the frame, where the portrait would be, sits a softly glowing blank laptop screen. Around it a wooden palette with oil paints, brushes in a jar, heavy velvet drapery and one candle. The easel and frame sit in the lower 60% of the frame; the top 35% is calm, dark, empty studio wall in warm shadow. Portrait 2:3, natural warm colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

A smartphone in a small black tripod stands at eye level on a wooden table near a window, facing a plain wall; a sheer curtain glows softly; a stack of books and a small plant beside the tripod. The table and tripod sit in the lower 55% of the frame; the top 45% is an empty, plain, soft lime-green (#cde58c) painted wall, gently out of focus. Portrait 2:3, natural colours.
